**The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was that the `en` (enable) signal was never used in the design. According to the specification, when `en` is low, the count and `gray` output should hold their values, but the original implementation incremented on every clock edge regardless of the `en` signal.

**The fix:** I changed line 14 from `end else begin` to `end else if (en) begin` to make the counter and output updates conditional on the `en` signal being high. Now the design correctly implements the specification: the counter only increments and the output only updates when `en` is high.
